# Aggelos Mouzakitis

> Advisor and licensed psychotherapist (BACP) for tech founders and solopreneurs. For business problems that trace back to something in you — worked on both tracks at once, the inner one and the business one. Based in Ireland, working globally.

Aggelos Mouzakitis works privately with a small number of tech founders and solopreneurs. Before training as a psychotherapist he spent 18+ years in tech, in product and growth — building companies and advising more than 500 of them. Clients come to him because they don't have to explain their world to a therapist who has never shipped anything, and they don't have to leave the personal stuff at the door for a coach who only wants the business version. The work runs on two tracks at once: the inner pattern that's actually driving the problem, and the business decision in front of you. It might be a decision you keep circling, something you keep avoiding, or a kind of pressure that never really switches off.

## Advisory (start here)

- [For Founders](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/founders/): Founder advisory for business problems that trace back to you. You'd give someone else in your position the right advice without blinking, and you still don't do it yourself — that gap is the tell. Knowing the pattern and being free of it are different jobs.
- [For Solopreneurs](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/solopreneurs/): For solopreneurs and independent consultants whose stuck sales, pricing fear, avoidance of being seen, or endless direction-switching trace back to a pattern in them, not a tactics problem.
- [How I Work](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/how-i-work/): Three steps — a free ~15-minute fit call, one paid session (you leave with a clear read and one real move, documented in a handover), then ongoing one-to-one work if it's worth it. The ongoing work runs on two tracks: the inner track (find the pattern, rewire it) and the business track (the decision, the move, the plan).
- [Book a Fit Call](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/book/): Free ~15-minute call to see if working together makes sense. Not a session.

## Focused pages

- [Therapy for Founders](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/therapy-for-founders/): For founders carrying what they can't say out loud — the isolation, identity loss after exit, investor pressure, existential doubt, and the question of who they are when the company isn't doing well.
- [Therapy for Executives](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/therapy-for-executives/): Psychotherapy for executives and senior leaders in tech who've done everything right and still feel something is off — identity enmeshment with performance, isolation of seniority, and patterns coaching alone can't reach.
- [Imposter Syndrome Therapy](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/imposter-syndrome-therapy/): For senior tech professionals dealing with shame-driven achievement and chronic self-doubt. The doubt is real; the story it tells you isn't.
- [Executive Burnout Therapy](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/executive-burnout-therapy/): For high-functioning burnout that rest doesn't fix — rooted in identity patterns, not just overwork.
- [Career Transition Therapy](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/career-transition-therapy/): For senior professionals navigating a working life that no longer feels genuinely fulfilling — toward clarity, not just another impressive move.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/blog/): Essays and video episodes on founder psychology, high-functioning burnout, performance identity, imposter syndrome, shame-driven achievement, and the cost of success. Published weekly.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfeHgYhNWwIRgWyRW9J0YCA): Conversations and episodes on the same themes, including the "What Went Wrong" series.

## Tools

- [High-Performance Fulfilment Diagnostic](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/burnout-diagnostic/): Free 45-question diagnostic — maps pressure, achievement patterns, nervous system load, meaning, and recovery. Takes approximately 8 minutes.

## Credentials & Entity

- Name: Aggelos Mouzakitis
- Profession: Advisor & Licensed Psychotherapist
- Accreditation: Registered Member, British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (BACP)
- Location: Ireland (working globally — clients mostly in Europe, the US, and Canada)
- Languages: English, Greek
- Experience: 18+ years in tech, in product and growth — building companies and advising more than 500 of them, including work inside IBM's enterprise portfolio
- Positioning: Not therapy by the protocol, not coaching with a framework — a private advisory relationship that works the inner pattern and the business decision at once
- Topics: founder psychology, solopreneur psychology, avoidance and procrastination in business, pricing fear, decision paralysis, high-functioning burnout, imposter syndrome, shame-driven achievement, identity enmeshment, nervous system regulation
